objective: A source-audited, high-signal Zurich/Zug technology directory, not a numerical quota.

structuralAudit.result: At1191 organisations, no structural issues except17 empty topic lists requiring explicit broad-institution, investor or excluded-record treatment; Stableton is the newly reviewed broad investor
structuralAudit.limitation: Structural checks do not prove current activity, semantic classification, source completeness or valid logo artwork

assetAudit.limitation: Successful downloads, decoding, hashes and CORS do not alone establish correct brand ownership or visual quality

industry.limitation: These are researcher-reported finite queues from a historical registry baseline, not confirmed omissions. Fresh identity and alias reconciliation is required before further preparation. A failed single-logo download must not block source assessment.

portfolio.limitation: Snapshot reported against 1133 organisations; recent verified imports must be reconciled, and source coverage remains incomplete

reviewCheckpoint.remaining: Finish finite source dispositions and reviewed preparation; reconcile every existing-listing decision; resolve removal approvals; perform final complete structural, semantic, artwork and mobile/desktop review

sourceGroups.name: Investor portfolios
sources: Other qualifying investors in the registry

existingListingReview.scope: Every company/startup, including new imports; separate institutional and investor criteria remain in force.
existingListingReview.actions: Review own technology, continued activity, identity and eligibility. Remove confirmed ineligible public map locations through supported controls after central review, preserving organisations and relationships.

verifiedCaptures.limitation: A complete capture of this company directory is not a completed eligibility review or evidence that every Swiss biotech organisation is listed.

verifiedCaptures.method: Main Chrome public directory and Zurich canton filter
verifiedCaptures.limitation: The rendered directory returned no membership results after selecting ZH. This does not mean no members exist; sector lists remain partial alternative evidence.

sourceAccounting.finiteDirectories: Reconcile all available entries, including relevant alumni, without an age cutoff.
sourceAccounting.newsAndJobs: Review current listings and the past 24 months; follow older evidence when needed to resolve candidates.
sourceAccounting.discovery: Portfolios, jobs, news and maps identify candidates; inclusion still requires primary-source evidence.
sourceAccounting.completion: A captured source is not a completed review. Inaccessible sources and unresolved evidence must remain explicit limitations.

activityReview.caution: Sparse social activity, a one-person team, an old website or a young prelaunch business alone does not establish inactivity.
activityReview.investigate: Corroborate multiple dormancy signals, dissolution, acquisition or discontinued products before excluding or merging identities.

publicationRequirements: Verified in-scope public address with truthful address type
Genuine legible logo or verified parent logo
Official website or equivalent authoritative presence
Social accounts checked and verified where found

checks: All existing company eligibility reviews accounted for
Confirmed low-quality listings removed from map
Repository diff review and commit suggestions
finalReview.honesty: Do not claim universal ecosystem completeness or count unresolved candidates as exclusions.
